main.description: The site's metadata, for search engines and link previews: its name, description and keywords, who it's by, their profiles, and per-page titles and descriptions; and the site's frame: the menu, the footer's links and what the sidebar shows; and what every post page shows. One record, key 'self'. A field left out uses the built-in value (src/data/site-meta.ts).

name.description: The site's name, e.g. 'Skiddle': shown by link previews and search results.

description.description: What a page says about itself when it has no description of its own.

keywords.description: Keywords for every page; a post adds its tags, and a page's own keywords come first.

profiles.description: Jeff's profiles elsewhere, e.g. https://bsky.app/profile/skiddle.blue: each page links to them as his (rel="me").

menu.description: The sidebar's links, in order. The search (Ctrl+K) lists them too. Left out, the sidebar has the built-in menu (src/data/frame.ts).

footerLinks.description: The footer's links, in order, after the version. Left out, the footer has the built-in links (src/data/frame.ts).

hideMusic.description: Hide the sidebar's music card (what Jeff is playing, or played last). Left out, or false, shows it, as today.

hideThemeButtons.description: Hide the sidebar's light/dark and accent buttons, and their commands in the search. Left out, or false, shows them, as today.

hideSeriesBox.description: On a post that is part of a series, hide the series box (which part it is, the series' progress and its parts), at the top of the post and in its side column on wide screens. The 'Next in …' card at the end of the post stays. Left out, or false, shows it, as today.

hideComments.description: Hide the Comments section at the end of every post (the replies to the post's Bluesky thread, or the line asking readers to start one). The post's link to its thread stays in its record. Left out, or false, shows it, as today.

pages.description: A page's own title, description and keywords, over what the page says itself.

author.description: Who the site is by, for search engines' knowledge of him (schema.org Person).

alternateName.description: Another name he goes by, e.g. 'Skiddle'.

worksFor.description: His company, e.g. 'Skiddle Labs Pte. Ltd.'.

knowsAbout.description: What he knows about, e.g. 'Protocol engineering'.

title.description: The whole title, as the browser tab and search results show it.

noindex.description: Ask search engines not to list it.

icon.description: The site's icon, in the sizes pages use: the browser tab (32 px), iPhone home screens (180 px), Android (192 px) and search engines' picture of Jeff (512 px). The admin app makes them from one square image. Without it, the built-in icons in /public are used.

source.description: The image they were made from.

link.description: A link in the site's frame.

href.description: A page on the site, starting with / (e.g. /posts/), or an https:// or mailto: address. The site leaves out a link that is none of these.

menuItem.description: A link in the sidebar's menu.

href.description: A page on the site, starting with / (e.g. /posts/), or an https:// or mailto: address. The site leaves out a link that is none of these.

icon.description: An icon from the site's set, before the label. Left out, none, as today.
